inputs.warning: Ideal equal-stiffness linear 3D bolt-group reaction; no flange contact or preload, friction, material strengths, shock dynamics, safety certification.

interpretation: The signed reactions are linear-compliance idealizations, compression is not a bolt's tensile load and positive tension is not automatically borne by bolts without flange contact mechanics.
True preload, gasket compression, friction and flange prying can move forces substantially.
Bolt count below eight represents a hypothetical out-of-service fastener case, not a permitted operation.
No bolt stress strengths, MDF tear-out or dynamic transient qualification established.
